intro: Chakuyak is an exceptionally aggressive prairie wolf stalking the tree stands west of Stonebull Lake in Mulgore. Posing a growing threat to passing travelers, she has been marked for hunting by local tribesfolk who seek to secure the region while honoring the fallen beast's pelt.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.
She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other adventurers seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found the big friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Taking the life of such a beautiful creature is a sad event, but it was necessary for the safety of our people. I will make certain that the pelt does not go to waste. Thank you.
